main_library.notes: Reviewed for the official architecture, dialogue protocol, classifier-free guidance, audio prompting, delay pattern, DAC integration, and generation defaults. VoiceHub does not execute this provider package.

architecture_reference.notes: Reviewed configuration_dia.py, modeling_dia.py, generation_dia.py, processing_dia.py, tokenization_dia.py, feature_extraction_dia.py, and the Dia-specific logits processors. VoiceHub ports the graph and loss semantics using only PyTorch and VoiceHub.

checkpoint.notes: The complete public index namespace exactly equals the native state dictionary: 335 names, zero missing names, zero extra names, and 1,611,160,576 parameters.

audio_codec.notes: Loaded through VoiceHub's native DAC architecture. Codec parameters are frozen while constructing Dia targets and are included in portable exports.

legacy_checkpoint.reason: The original pickle/Nari layout is not the strict converted Safetensors namespace used for native end-to-end training. VoiceHub rejects it with a migration message instead of executing pickle or an upstream runtime.

inference: classifier-free guidance and Dia EOS rules
training: full backward through every Dia parameter
limitations: The reference 1.6B weights are too large for routine CPU CI, so CI verifies the exact public namespace/header inventory and runs numerical graph, checkpoint, generation, export, reload, and backward tests on shape-reduced configurations.
The baseline native generator recomputes decoder prefixes. KV-cache and compiled execution are optional optimization strategies and do not alter the architecture graph.
No accuracy improvement is claimed; no corpus-level audio quality benchmark has been run.
